meta.title: Token Pacer — never hit the cap by surprise
meta.description: Claude Code, Codex and Copilot quotas live in your Mac's notch. Real numbers, straight from each provider. No account, no API key, no permissions.
meta.ogAlt: Token Pacer — a green-to-red usage scale at 62%, with 2h 14m to reset.

hero.eyebrow: For macOS · lives in the notch
headlines: Never hit the cap by surprise
hero.sub: You find out you were at 94% by being told you're at 100% — mid-task, on the afternoon it matters. Token Pacer keeps Claude Code, Codex and Copilot in front of you all day, so you never have to ask.

features.label: Always there, never in the way
features.note: Lives in the notch. No notch? It docks in the menu bar, on whichever display you pick.

features.label: Every agent, side by side
features.note: Claude Code, Codex and Copilot on one scale, each on its own reset. Click one to pin it to the menu bar.

features.label: Real numbers only
features.note: Every figure is the provider's own. When one can't be read, it says so and why — never a guess.

features.label: Warns you once, then waits
features.note: Give each agent its own amber and red lines. Cross one and the pill opens by itself until you look.

features.label: Nothing to sign into
features.note: No account, no API key, no permission prompts. It reads the CLI you already run and sends nothing but an update check.

features.label: Light on the Mac it watches
features.note: Native Swift, no web view. The drawing runs on CoreAnimation, so it idles cheap and stays cool.

demo.label: Token Pacer in the notch, cycling through its states

captions.pill: Collapsed — what you've used, and when it resets
captions.working: Working — the light runs, the badge counts sessions answering
captions.hover: Hover — every agent on one scale; click a row to pin it
captions.panel: Double-click — 90 days of history, by model, project and kind
captions.warn: Cross your line and it opens by itself, until you look
captions.red: At the cap — just a red countdown to the reset
captions.reset: Window resets — back to full, on its own
captions.prefs: Each agent gets its own amber and red lines
captions.looks: Twelve marks, twelve running lights — pick by watching, not by name

prefs.tracked: Tracked automatically. Drag to set where each one turns amber and red.
